Cash $50,000, so funding is fine. I could buy ~44 shares at $222.70 = $9,798.80. Let's do 44 shares at limit $223.00 (slightly above ask $222.72 to be near market and fillable). Actually "limit prices must be close to the current market price" — $223.00 is 0.13% above market. Fine.

44 × $223.00 = $9,812 max. Under $10,000. Good.

Let me place the order.
